\documentclass{ximera}
\usepackage{answer}
\usepackage{hint}

\title{ximera-hint fixture}
\author{Phase 0}

\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
Fixture for the \texttt{ximera-hint} spec. One problem with three hints, exercising per-hint click-to-reveal in document order. Non-answerable component: revealing a hint MUST NOT set any answerable's \texttt{complete}.
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

\begin{problem}
  What is $2 + 2$?

  My favorite value is $y = \answer{4}$.

  \begin{hint}
    First, count on your fingers.
  \end{hint}

  \begin{hint}
    If you run out of fingers, count on your toes.
  \end{hint}

  \begin{hint}
    The answer is an even number less than five.
  \end{hint}
\end{problem}

\end{document}
